notablePrerequisites:
You conrol noncreature artifacts with a total mana value of 10 or greater.
"Mirran" chosen with Mirrodin Besieged.
description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying at most {1}.
Mirrodin Besieged triggers, creating a 1/1 Myr artifact creature token.
When Metalwork Colossus enters the battlefield, Genesis Chamber triggers, creating a 1/1 Myr artifact creature token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing the two Myrs, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
